# LoopSplit

> Official website and user documentation for LoopSplit, a shared expense app for iPhone, iPad and Android. Updated November 12, 2026. Available on the App Store and Google Play.

LoopSplit records shared expenses, recurring bills and repayments. It does not transfer money or connect to a bank. Users choose equal, shares, percentage or exact-amount splits. Receipt scanning suggests an amount, merchant and date when available; users review suggestions before saving.

Free use has no ads or daily expense limits. Each free Book supports three active Loops. Free receipt scanning is three scans total per account across devices; attaching and viewing receipt photos is free. Optional Pro subscriptions add unlimited scanning, cropping, Loops and estimated expenses. A Pro member shares Book-level Pro benefits with the other members of that Book. Local prices and trial eligibility appear in the store purchase flow.

Recurring bills: a Loop saves the schedule, payer and split; members review and record each due period in To Do. It does not pay a bill automatically. Pending tips: Pro supports an estimated shared expense, included in balances after save and sync, with its final total confirmed on the same entry. Equal, percentage and shares splits are supported for estimates; exact-amount splits are not. Members can confirm an existing estimate without their own Pro subscription. Pending means an amount marked by the user, not a bank connection or tip-posting detector.

Receipt auto-fill: Pro scans automatically; free users request a scan using their remaining account allowance. Recognition suggests amount, merchant and date when available, on the device, not through cloud OCR. Free scans require a connection to check the allowance. Saved shared receipt attachments upload to the Book for its members to view. Users review suggestions and choose the split; scanning does not allocate individual items, calculate tips or save an expense automatically.

## Product
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.loop.loopsplit): Official Android app.
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6817176363): Official iPhone and iPad app.
- [Official website](https://loopsplit.app/): Product overview and iOS/Android store links.
- [Help Center](https://loopsplit.app/support/): Version-specific instructions and support contact.
- [Free features and Pro](https://loopsplit.app/support/pro/): Limits, shared benefits, subscriptions and restore help.

## Guides
- [Splitting rent and utilities](https://loopsplit.app/guides/split-rent-and-utilities/): A worked roommate example.
- [Shared expenses for couples](https://loopsplit.app/guides/shared-expenses-for-couples/): Equal, percentage and exact splits.
- [Recurring shared bills](https://loopsplit.app/guides/recurring-shared-bills/): Recurring bill splitting, a rent-and-internet example, free Loops and variable amounts.
- [Split bills with pending tips](https://loopsplit.app/guides/split-bills-with-pending-tips/): A USD 120 estimate becomes USD 132 final; Pro requirements and confirmation steps.
- [Scan receipts and split expenses](https://loopsplit.app/guides/scan-receipts-split-expenses/): Receipt auto-fill, free scans versus Pro, on-device OCR and shared attachment privacy.

## Languages

Homepages and practical guides are available in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, Spanish, Italian and Japanese. Detailed help articles are currently English. Privacy and Terms are available in English and Simplified Chinese.
